tool.name: nf-core racon
tool.description: Consensus module for raw de novo DNA assembly of long uncorrected reads
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ racon -t "$task.cpus" \\ "${reads}" \\ "${paf}" \\ $args \\ "${assembly}" > \\ ${prefix}_assembly_consensus.fasta
gzip -n ${prefix}_assembly_consensus.fasta
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": racon: \$( racon --version 2>&1 | sed 's/^.*v//' ) END_VERSIONS ]]>
